name: Kumamon Bomber Puzzle de Kumamon Taisou
summary: Kum-mon ☆ Bomber: Puzzle de Kuma-mon Taisō is a puzzle game for the Nintendo 3DS, featuring the popular Kumamon mascot. The game combines puzzle-solving mechanics with rhythmic exercises, encouraging players to engage in fun and interactive gameplay.
